report.summary: Chunk 3 of 15: defines data classes (OperationStatus, IngestReport, SearchReport, IndexStatus), exception classes, EmbeddingBackend protocol, OllamaEmbeddingBackend implementation, and _pack_embedding function stub.
risks: SearchReport.freshness docstring | medium | Claim that freshness defaults to "unanchored" is correct, but explanation of semantics is uncheckable. | Verify that JournalPosition callers can raise freshness above "unanchored" in actual usage.

IndexStatus.identity_anchor docstring | medium | Docstring claims "created" is laid down when index first written, "adopted" retrofitted; these are uncheckable. | Confirm that IndexStatus is set accordingly in index creation/adoption logic.
IndexStatus.revision_pinned docstring | low | Docstring claims it's False when spec alone cannot distinguish weights; uncheckable. | Verify that revision_pinned is set correctly in practice.
_pack_embedding function stub | high | Function declared but body not present in this chunk; callers will fail. | Implement _pack_embedding or confirm it exists later.
OllamaEmbeddingBackend.embed | medium | Uses urllib.request.urlopen with timeout; may hang if timeout is large; no retry logic. | Consider adding retry or connection pooling.
todos: Add retry logic or connection pooling to OllamaEmbeddingBackend.embed for robustness.

handoff.purpose: Define data classes, exceptions, embedding protocol, Ollama backend, and partial utility function.

claims.text: ``"fresh"``, ``"stale"``, ``"forked"`` or ``"unanchored"``.  Defaults to ``"unanchored"`` - freshness UNKNOWN, not freshness confirmed.  Only a caller-supplied :class:`JournalPosition` can raise it above that.
claims.why: The docstring describes semantics of freshness values and dependency on JournalPosition, which are not defined in this chunk.
Points to SearchReport.freshness for semantics, but that attribute's semantics are themselves uncheckable.

claims.text: ``"missing"``, ``"created"`` (laid down when the index was first written, therefore authoritative) or ``"adopted"`` (retrofitted over pre-existing vectors, therefore trust-on-first-use).
claims.why: The meanings of 'created' and 'adopted' rely on index creation logic not present in this chunk.

claims.text: False when the declared spec alone cannot distinguish two different sets of weights behind one movable model tag.
claims.why: The condition for setting revision_pinned is not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: Return exactly one vector per input text.
claims.why: The docstring claims exactly one vector per text, but the method signature returns list[list[float]]; the implementation in OllamaEmbeddingBackend returns the raw embeddings list from the API, which should satisfy this, but no validation is done. However, the claim is about the protocol's contract; since the protocol does not enforce this, it's broken at the specification level.
The class implements a POST to /api/embed with batched input (list of texts).
The code explicitly checks `if not texts: return []`.

claims.text: Raise EmbeddingUnavailableError on URLError or OSError.
claims.why: The except block catches urllib.error.URLError and OSError and raises EmbeddingUnavailableError.

claims.text: Raise EmbeddingProtocolError on JSON decode errors.
claims.why: The except block catches json.JSONDecodeError and UnicodeDecodeError and raises EmbeddingProtocolError.

claims.text: Raise EmbeddingProtocolError if response has no embeddings array.
claims.why: The code checks if embeddings is not a list and raises EmbeddingProtocolError.

observations.what: The variable 'source' at module level is of type Optional[str] with value None; its purpose is unclear.
SearchReport.freshness docstring claims JournalPosition can raise freshness above 'unanchored', but no JournalPosition class is imported or referenced in this chunk.
IndexStatus.identity_anchor docstring describes 'created' and 'adopted' values, but the code only defines the default 'missing'.
OllamaEmbeddingBackend.embed uses synchronous urllib.request; no async or connection pooling.
_pack_embedding function is declared but has no body (just a stub).
OllamaEmbeddingBackend.embed does not validate that the response contains exactly one embedding per input text.
